title: Turning Parts Department OFF then ON keeps the 3 child card choices
custom_preconds: 1. In the role editor: Parts Department ON, with Part sales View + Create & Edit, Catalog and Inventory View, and Vendor and order management View/Create & Edit/Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Turn Parts Department OFF.
  2. Notice the 3 child cards are hidden.
  3. Turn Parts Department ON again.
  4. Look at the child card boxes.
custom_expected:
The child cards hide when Parts Department is off.

When turned back on, all the previous box choices are kept, not reset.
